Hey, I'm Jessica — I get personal with every event.

I'm not a rental company that drops off a bar. I'm the person texting you about your color palette at 10pm, hand-washing custom cups that say “In Honor Of” for your dad, picking marigolds that match your papel picado.

How I work: You tell me the vibe — arcade Pac-Man for Ezra, black & gold PEREZ for Ramiro's 50th, gothic skulls for Halloween, cowboy boots for Camilla's Sweet 16 western — and I design drinks from my 32-drink master list + signage + garnishes around it. No more white/black longsleeve in Bio — now it's behind-the-bar like you asked.

“I loved how you remembered it was my mom's favorite flower and put it on every drink. My guests are still talking about the mangonadas.” — Carolyn's 50th Fiesta, Riverside

What you get: Tasting call, custom proposal with 3-5 drinks from my REAL sheet (Cherry Blossom-tini to Strawberries and Cream Marg), custom cups + light-up letters + floral garnish, beautiful menu board for photos, and batch calculations from my Bar Batch Bible.
